context: 2 DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION 3 DOSAGE FORMS AND STRENGTHS MEPRON is a bright yellow, citrus-flavored, oral suspension containing 750 mg of atovaquone per 5 mL. MEPRON is supplied in 210-mL bottles or 5-mL foil pouches.
